projectName: Seminarios y Eventos UIM – FES Acatlán
projectDescription: A static web page for FES Acatlán (UNAM) that lists and filters research seminars, allowing users to browse annual, permanent, and special seminars and submit enrollment requests.
keyFeatures: Seminar catalog with card-based layout displaying annual, permanent, and special seminars
Category filter buttons (All, Annual, Permanent, Special) with real-time filtering
Full-text search across seminar title, objective, and responsible researcher
Enrollment modal form with user type detection (internal FES Acatlán vs external)
Conditional account number field that appears only for internal users
Expandable seminar objective text with 'Ver más / Ver menos' toggle
Responsive CSS grid layout adapting to different screen sizes
Modular CSS architecture split across reset, layout, components, typography, and utilities
publicApiSurface: seminarios[] data array in js/seminarios.js — add/edit seminar objects here
Seminar object fields: tipo, titulo, objetivo, responsable, correo, telefono, areas, imagen
CSS files: css/reset.css, css/layout.css, css/components.css, css/typography.css, css/utilities.css
